hypothesis: Can an isolated tokenless local-plasticity associative memory infer sparse and denser unknown-outdegree signed causal relationships that persist or change under context, using only actual intervention/outcome observations, and match or beat fully fitted same-information controls? Preserve null results against the strongest eligible conventional model.

worlds.fixed_action_context_order: for source 0..N-1, context 0..1, replicate 0..R-1, action 0 then 1; per-source two-context paired public observations; R=24 reported first, then R=12/6 diagnostic from same deterministic hash-prefixed world
worlds.graph_generation: Hidden per-source outdegree = [0,1,2,4,8][SHA256_first8('F45/degree/v1|N|seed|source')%5]. Rank other target IDs by SHA256_first8('F45/edge/v1|N|seed|source|target'), choose first outdegree, assign sign + if SHA256_first8('F45/sign/v1|N|seed|source|target') parity=0 else −; no self edges. No candidate edge/degree disclosed to learners.
worlds.public_outcome: For every (source, context, action, replicate), expose one entire N-target binary outcome vector after the intervention. Noise is SHA256_first8('F45/obs/v1|N|seed|source|context|action|replicate|target'), success if hash < numerator*(2**64//8). Non-edges numerator=2 (probability 1/4) for both actions/contexts. Signed link acts with probability 7/8 for preferred action, 1/4 for nonpreferred action. Invariant law: preferred action is action1 for + sign or action0 for − sign in both contexts. Context-gated: only context1 reveals link; context0 is no-effect. Context-flip: sign in context1 is inverse of context0.
worlds.world_custody: All nine synthetic worlds generated after protocol freeze; development-only fixed seeds and public laws, not unseen protected science.

trainers.native_style: Two context-specific int16 signed contrast weights per (source,target); per balanced public intervention update w[context,source,target]+=(2*action-1)*(2*outcome-1); no gradients or hidden edge source; class signed effect if weight>=2*ceil(0.45*R) or <=negative, otherwise abstain. Requires both actions sampled equally.
trainers.fully_fitted_factorized: Fully fitted independent per-source/context/target Bernoulli treatment and control maximum-likelihood success frequencies; same public actions and outcomes; signed class using fixed 0.45 fitted difference. This has exactly the same sufficient statistic as native; parity is an honest required control.
trainers.strongest_family_aware: Constrained least-squares projection fitted per (source,target) over all three declared response-difference patterns [1,1] invariant, [0,1] gated, [1,-1] flip, and both edge polarities. Choose pattern with maximum squared explained signed-effect energy = (dot(d,pattern))**2/sum(pattern**2), deterministic pattern order tie break, let amplitude=dot(d,pattern)/sum(pattern**2). Accept only if abs(amplitude)>=0.45; emit context-specific signed edges accordingly. All 3 patterns are known to every arm before experiment; do NOT feed which world mode or actual outdegree to the conventional control. Report strongest comparator results even if it beats native.
trainers.symbolic_oracle: Hidden signed graph for exact evaluator only; exclude ambiguous multi-path and diagonal two-hop pairs; no learner access.
shams: Wrong-source permutation -> lower direct F1 at max budget
For source N-1, real held-in-budget intervention must leave previously learned source0 weight rows unchanged

evaluation.direct_truth: All directed signed causal links by source,target,context; two contexts, unknown outdegree, omit self; no-link pairs are negatives even if another context contains an edge.
evaluation.twohop_truth: Signed product of exactly one directed two-hop path in each fixed context; exclude returns to source and pairs with more than one true two-hop path, whether signs agree or disagree. Apply same exclusion mask to predicted paths for control consistency.
evaluation.candidate_domain: All 2*N*(N-1) direct triples and each context's N*(N-1) two-hop endpoint-pairs, no global-world negative claim.
metrics: TP/FP/FN/TN, precision, recall and F1 per context, regime and world

evaluation.decision_rule: DEV_CONTEXTUAL_CAUSAL_INDUCTION_GO iff all frozen high-budget macro/worst-world thresholds and positive controls pass. Otherwise DEV_CONTEXTUAL_CAUSAL_INDUCTION_NO_GO. Report (NOT gate on) stronger family-aware control comparison; any learned gain is not scientific without independent prospective heldout source/seeds, matched compute, whole-process accounting, and independent qualification. Lower budgets cannot rescue high-budget failure.
evaluation.limits: No parameter/seed/law/graph edits after results. Post hoc insights are separate diagnostics and cannot revise these thresholds.
